description: An eight by eight matrix mixer: every input can be sent to every output at its own level, with a modulation jack for each of the sixty-four levels

params.text: Sets how much of that input goes into that output, 0 to 1, or -1 to 1 with biPolar on

inputs.text: One of the eight signals to be mixed, one channel per voice
Scales that one level by cable, 0-10V across nothing to full, multiplying the knob rather than adding to it

outputs.text: Carries the sum of the eight inputs at the levels set down its column

notes: an output with no cable in it is not computed at all, and an input with no cable counts as silence
a modulation jack multiplies its knob, so a level whose knob is at zero stays silent however high the modulation goes
the voltage at a modulation jack is not clamped, so more than 10V makes that level louder than the knob alone and a negative voltage turns the signal upside down
menu: biPolar — gives every level knob a span of -1 to 1 in place of 0 to 1, so a signal can be mixed in upside down
